rows.sourceStem: For what value of $k$ do $\begin{cases}2x+3y=10\\(k+3)x+(2k+2)y=41\end{cases}$ have **no solution**?
rows.reasonFromActualQuestionStructure: To obtain no solution, coefficients depending on k in both equations must become proportional, while the right-hand constants must be checked not coincident. This can assess a genuine classification decision, but all four share the same method.
rows.nonRoutineRedesignRequirement: Independent Grade 7+ comparison, extra parameter-case demand, individual six-distractor realism and a concept-family equivalence decision.
